capabilities_done: container.rs: in-crate bounded ZIP reader/writer over miniz_oxide (zip crate not used, see notes): entry count, entry size, total inflated size, expansion ratio (above 1 MiB), exact + case-folded duplicate names, traversal/absolute/backslash/drive names, mimetype first+stored+exact, local header vs central directory, overlapping entry data, CRC-32; ZIP64/encryption/other methods are typed refusals; deterministic writer (fixed timestamps, DEFLATE level 6 only when smaller, mimetype stored)

idml_decode.rs: open_idml keeps EVERY part with sha256 (unknown parts quarantined verbatim); roxmltree with allow_dtd=false (any DOCTYPE refused as EntityDenied) and a node limit; designmap -> ordered Spread/Story refs, DocumentPreference (page size, facing pages, bleed) and MarginPreference from Preferences parts; Spread -> Page (GeometricBounds, ItemTransform, page MarginPreference) and TextFrame (ParentStory, Previous/NextTextFrame, ItemTransform, path anchors, TextFramePreference columns/gutter/inset/vertical justification/first baseline/auto size); Story -> paragraphs and runs (AppliedParagraphStyle, AppliedCharacterStyle, AppliedLanguage, Content text with byte span, Br paragraph ends, StoryDirection); thread chain validation (reciprocal, acyclic, DanglingStory, link outside subset reported)

proposal.rs: Folio proposal through Folio's own boundary (inspect_bytes + validate_text_story): one StudioPageSpread per Spread with StudioPage (side from FacingPages and spine position, margins, bleed in pt), one text layer with text_frame per TextFrame (bounds converted to page coordinates of the max-overlap page, insets, thread links rebuilt from the validated chain), one StudioTextStory per Story (inline text, paragraph and character ranges tiling the stream, STYS style refs reported unresolved, sanitized language key, story/paragraph direction); IdMint-injected ids with an IDML->Folio id map

typed loss report: LossEntry{part, element, kind: PreservedOpaque|Unsupported|Approximated|UnsupportedComposition, code, count} sorted deterministically; graphics, groups, guides, master spreads, styles/swatches/fonts parts, tables, footnotes, special characters, off-page/rotated/curved frames, defaulted margins, outside-subset links; RTL/CJK/vertical/complex-script stories flagged reflow_certified=false

idml_encode.rs: replace_content (byte span of a Content element, stale part sha check, XML-escaped, every other byte of every part identical), write_idml (all parts verbatim, deterministic), export_idml (canonical regeneration of designmap/spreads/stories from the typed model with verbatim opaque children; fixed point under import->export->import)

indd_adapter.rs: identify_indd (GUID + DOCUMENT/BOOKBOOK/LIBRARY4 + endianness + version, header only) and import_indd whose Ok type is Infallible: always NativeEditabilityBlocked with the original bytes preserved, Unsupported for non-INDD; IDML never satisfies INDD

decisions_for_lead: zip =8.6.0 from the brief NOT used: absent from the local registry and Cargo.lock (closure unmeasured against the probe 35-package cap); an in-crate bounded reader/writer over miniz_oxide 0.9.1 (already locked by psd/vector/press) gives exact control of the STU-IO-187 checks and adds zero packages. Same direction as the package/press lead decisions. Dep-request lines appended (miniz_oxide, roxmltree features std+positions, sha2 force-soft, serde_json std). roxmltree `positions` is a cfg gate only (Node::range byte spans); interop-vector keeps it off, feature unification only adds the cfg code

Folio is built through serde_json wire + inspect_bytes/validate_text_story (as interop-psd does), not StudioDocument struct literals, so Folio field additions by other lanes cannot break this crate's compile

Two write paths on purpose: replace_content+write_idml are byte-exact for everything; export_idml regenerates only designmap/spreads/stories from the typed model and drops what the decoder reported as `unsupported` (tables, footnotes, special characters); `preserved_opaque` content (graphic page items, Properties, Resources, master spreads) survives both. Model fields marked `derived` (margins, frame path/prefs, language) are read from verbatim children and are not written back
Folio keeps ONE chain per story: a story with a second disjoint chain (after a link outside the subset) projects only the first chain and reports extra_thread_chain_not_projected
Document colour mode is assumed RGB (3) with unassigned working spaces and reported as approximated colour_mode_assumed_rgb; swatches/profiles are not imported
StoryText for Folio: Content text, a Br contributes one newline ending the paragraph; unterminated final paragraph has no trailing newline

No layout crate use in slice 1: overset and reflow are not computed; stories with RTL/CJK/vertical/complex-script markers are flagged reflow_certified=false (language name lists are a heuristic, completeness UNVERIFIED)
not_proven: No InDesign-produced IDML or INDD fixture exists on this machine: all packages are synthetic and built from the public IDML structure (Craft importer used as behaviour reference only, no code copied). Real-world variants (xml:space, CDATA, UTF-16 parts, BOM, frames inside Group/anchored objects, XMLElement-tagged text, HyperlinkTextSource wrapping Content) are NOT proven; unknown children are reported, but text inside HyperlinkTextSource/XMLElement/Footnote/Table is not imported
INDD header layout is from the public PRONOM registry (fmt/548, fmt/1191, fmt/1192), UNVERIFIED on an InDesign-saved file; only the 29-byte header is read; no decoder exists and none is claimed

Page side for single-page facing spreads uses the spine position (page right edge <= 0 is left-hand); right-to-left binding is not handled; page margin left/right as inside/outside follows the IDML name, UNVERIFIED against InDesign output for single-sided pages
Default margins when MarginPreference is absent are set to 0 and reported (the IDML default is UNVERIFIED)
InDesign's own reopen of an exported IDML (black-box oracle, D5) has not been run; export_idml correctness is proven only as a fixed point of this crate's decoder
Cargo.lock in the shared worktree is modified by local cargo runs for this crate's new dependency edges; not staged (steward sync derives the lock)
